source_state: Approved corpus baseline 2.2, initially prepared in English, with paired language versions of all nine governing documents. No language is designated authoritative. baseline_tag and baseline path/hash fields identify the original approved files; current hashes and document metadata identify the reconciled files. DR-2026-064 records the industry-terminology reconciliation. Vocabulary and Style and Document Catalog are now revision 3.3; Portfolio Management Model is revision 2.2. Shared Business and Technology Terminology edition 1.5 has separate English and Russian corpus files, each containing definitions and application in its own language. Each portal route and search index uses its own language edition. The historical baseline hashes remain unchanged. This comparison state does not claim live publication. Fixed international names applied across both language sources and portal content; shared reference edition 1.5 and governing Vocabulary/Document Catalog revision 3.3. Russian explanatory names and permitted variants retained.
scope: Charter corpus, Registry records, Portfolio records and definitions, portal explanatory content, English interface messages, English authored content, and page routing. Operational status is preserved; this manifest is not evidence of approval or publication.

hash_bases.file_bytes: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 source file bytes.
hash_bases.english_projection: Recursively replace every nonempty object whose keys are a subset of en, ru, ky with its en value; retain all other keys and list order. Serialize with JSON keys sorted, no spaces, Unicode unescaped, UTF-8, no trailing newline. SHA-256 that serialization.

translation_rule: Record the comparison edition and each referenced document revision. Preserve identifiers with only the language suffix changed, normative force, defined terms, decision rights, dates, approval status, and recorded uncertainty. Reconcile changes in either language against recorded decisions and change history, without automatic language precedence. Do not refresh this baseline merely because a translation is added.
